name: Long Beach
note: 16km of surf beach in Pacific Rim NP, walk it at low tide

name: Cox Bay Beach
note: Tofino's most consistent surf break, lessons at the resorts

name: Chesterman Beach
note: tidepools and a walkable sandbar to Frank Island at low tide

name: Tonquin Beach Trail
note: short rainforest boardwalk to a sheltered sunset cove, from town

name: Rainforest Trail
note: two 1km boardwalk loops through old-growth cedar and hemlock

name: Schooner Cove Trail
note: 1km boardwalk down to the quiet north end of Long Beach

name: Radar Hill
note: drive-up WWII radar site, Clayoquot Sound panorama

name: Kwisitis Visitor Centre
note: exhibits on Nuu-chah-nulth culture, above Wickaninnish Beach

name: Green Point Campground
note: the only campground inside Pacific Rim NP, book ahead

name: Tofino Brewing Co
note: tasting room by the harbour, kelp stout is the local one

name: Tacofino
note: the original food truck, fish tacos worth the line

name: Meares Island Big Tree Trail
note: water taxi or kayak from town, 1500-year-old cedars

name: Hot Springs Cove
note: natural hot springs, boat or floatplane day trip from Tofino

name: Wild Pacific Trail
note: clifftop loop at Ucluelet lighthouse, storm-watching favourite
